description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee the daily management and strategic direction of a facility committed to providing exceptional patient care and rehabilitation services.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for enhancing resident quality of life and ensuring regulatory compliance. You will be instrumental in fostering a positive work environment, optimizing operational efficiency, and driving continuous improvement initiatives within the facility.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license.
Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead, manage, and inspire a diverse team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $115,000 - $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
